runtime.mode: headless print mode (-p), disposable temp project, project-scope hooks

verified_live: neutral install leaves host settings untouched (no .claude dir before setup)
explicit scoped setup writes exactly the two owned hook entries
startup SessionStart fired in the real host: session state file created and the model answered active_mode=full
resume SessionStart fired in the real host: capsule re-injected (active_mode=full observed)
session stop phrase (normal mode) parsed by UserPromptSubmit: stopped=true persisted in session state
persistent project disable via adapter CLI: defaults mode=off
exact uninstall removed both owned entries and purged adapter state
failed_or_unverified: slash-form triggers (/super-caveman ...) were consumed by the host command layer and never reached UserPromptSubmit verbatim, so live mode switch, one-shot route, and status-route delivery are unverified in this attempt
compact was not forced in the live host; startup/resume/stop/disable/uninstall are the live steps (compact semantics proven by the deterministic lifecycle cases)

limitations: headless -p cannot grant host hook trust interactively; hooks fired without an explicit trust step in this environment and interactive trust behavior is unverified
one scripted attempt; no retry, no cherry-picking
model replies recorded as short redacted observations, no raw prompts or private history stored
adapter state digests and step artifacts are synthetic-session evidence only
